exposure: Pregnancy monitoring during the COVID-19 pandemic
Women who gave birth before the pandemic
Pregnancy monitoring before the COVID-19 pandemic
Women who gave birth during the pandemic
finding: Pregnant women who gave birth before the COVID-19 pandemic had more frequent doctor visits, fewer caesarean sections, and higher rates of skin-to-skin contact after birth compared to those who gave birth during the pandemic.
mod_finding: The number of caesarean and instrumental deliveries increased during the COVID-19 pandemic.
